home.desc: Your own corner above the arcade floor. Your soulbound runes hang on the wall beside your gallery; frens you invite can drop by. The stairs back down to the floor are south.

entrance.title: The Arcade Entrance
entrance.desc: CRT cabinets hum in the dark, throwing blue light across the carpet. A neon sign buzzes: PAC'S ARCADE — KNOWLEDGE IS THE HIGH SCORE. A worn token-slot glows, waiting. A stairwell descends into a cold blue glow.

dungeon.title: The Proof Dungeon
dungeon.desc: Down here the hum turns to a drone. Something vast and half-real coils in the dark, flickering between two places at once. It has been trying to spend the same coin twice since before you were born. Type  challenge  to face it.
art: /  x   x  \    something flickers between two places

alcove.title: The Oracle's Alcove
alcove.desc: A single cabinet stands apart, its screen a calm violet. A brass plate reads ASK, AND DEMONSTRATE. This is where the Oracle holds court, trading questions for understanding. It never lectures. It only asks.
art: ( o   o )     the Oracle waits, patient

vault.title: The Puzzle Vault
vault.desc: Cold stone, warmer than it looks. A great iron LEVER juts from the wall beside a sealed chest banded in gold. Etched above it: 'What is written here, only you may keep. Lose the scroll, lose the treasure.' The lever is a logic gate — pull it.
art: | [#]     ()  |   a sealed chest, banded in gold

academy.title: The Service Academy
academy.desc: A quiet room off the arcade floor: worn manuals on the shelves, a whiteboard still warm from the last class. This is where frens learn to run the node itself — to read a Duty Roster ticket and know which job it really is. The Instructor waits by the board. Say  talk instructor  to begin the trial. The Examination Hall is north; the entrance is back east.
art: │ INC PRB CHG   │   the board asks:
│ REQ ANM  ?    │   which ticket is which?

exam_hall.title: The Examination Hall
exam_hall.desc: Rows of empty seats face a single lectern under a cold spotlight. A sealed record-book waits on the stand — ready to stamp anyone who can prove they understand the craft, not just recite it. This is the practice exam. Type  challenge  to sit it. The Academy is back south.

oracle.name: the Oracle
oracle.persona: You are the Oracle at Pac's Arcade — a Socratic bitcoin/nostr educator in a MUD. Say 'fren', never 'friend'. Reply in 1-3 warm sentences and end with a probing question. Never lecture.
oracle.fallback: I trade in questions, not chit-chat, fren — but I'm listening. Ask me something real about bitcoin or nostr, or say 'talk oracle' to begin the trial. What's on your mind?

trial.question: With a bitcoin wallet there is ONE secret that is yours alone — lose it and the coins are gone, share it and they're stolen. What is that secret called?
trial.pass_line: You understood the stakes, not a definition.
trial.already: Yes — the seed phrase. But you already hold this rune, fren; I don't etch a truth twice. Wear it well.
trial.retry: Close — but feel the weight of it. Not your address, not your PIN. The one string of words that IS the money. Try again:  answer <text>

wraith.name: The Double-Spend Wraith
wraith.persona: You are the Double-Spend Wraith — a bitcoin consensus riddle-boss in a MUD. Menacing but fair; you teach through riddles about double-spends, mining and proof of work. Two sentences max.
wraith.question: "I am one coin, spent twice. I split the ledger and feast on the confusion. Name the mechanism that forces the whole network to agree on ONE history — and I unravel."
wraith.fail_hint: Think: what does a miner burn to extend the chain, making a rewrite absurdly expensive?   answer <text>
already_lines: The Wraith yields — but you've already mastered this truth.
No XP for a lesson you already own, fren. Come back when there's a
NEW boss with something new to teach. (Harder rematch questions and
boss riddles are on the way — see docs/ROADMAP.md.)
anim: it is in two places at once...

itil_instructor.name: the Instructor
itil_instructor.persona: You are the Instructor at Pac's Arcade Service Academy — a Socratic teacher of service-management basics (ITIL 4 concepts, taught in your own words, never official certification). Say 'fren', never 'friend'. Reply in 1-3 warm sentences and end with a probing question. Teach the craft of running a node; never lecture, never dump definitions.
itil_instructor.fallback: I teach the craft of keeping a node healthy, fren — reading a ticket and knowing the real job behind it. Ask me something real, or say  talk instructor  to begin the trial. What's on your mind?

trial.question: The game server just crashed and frens are locked out — you need it back NOW. Working out WHY it keeps crashing is a separate job for later. On the Duty Roster those are two different ticket kinds. What do we call the 'restore it now' one — the unplanned interruption to a running service?

class.title: Service Ops: Incident vs Problem (ITIL 4, unofficial)

trial.pass_line: Exactly, fren — the incident is the interruption you rush to restore; the problem is the cause you hunt so it stops coming back. Two tickets, two jobs.
trial.already: You already hold this one, fren — you know an incident from a problem. I don't etch a truth twice. Wear it well.
trial.retry: Not the root cause — that's the *problem*. Not a change, not a request. The live interruption you scramble to *restore*. Try again:  answer <text>

itil_exam.name: the Foundation Exam
itil_exam.persona: You are the Foundation Exam — a fair, plain-spoken examiner of service-management fundamentals (ITIL 4, taught unofficially) in a MUD. You test understanding, not memorisation, and you grant no official certification. Two sentences max.
itil_exam.question: "Seven principles guide every decision in this craft. The FIRST is the north star the other six orbit: nothing you build matters unless it serves this one thing for the frens you serve. Finish it — 'Focus on ____.'"
itil_exam.fail_hint: It's the word the whole framework orbits — what a service exists to co-create with the people who use it, not merely 'deliver'.   answer <text>
itil_exam.victory_line: the Examiner nods and stamps your record
already_lines: The Examiner nods — but your record already carries this stamp.
No XP for an exam you've already passed, fren. This is a practice
paper, never an official certification — the credential that counts
is the understanding you walked in with.

strings.welcome: Welcome, {who}. The high score is understanding. 💜
strings.welcome_back: Welcome back, {who}. Your progress was kept.
strings.cant_go: you can't go that way, fren
strings.come_back: Come back and we'll pick up right where you left off. 💜
